description: Typical form item that provides the ability to select from distinct values, convey approval/acknowledgement. Similar to `v-switch`.

props.indeterminate: Sets an indeterminate state for the checkbox.
props.indeterminateIcon: The icon used when in an indeterminate state.
props.multiple: Changes expected model to an array.
props.theme: Specify a theme for this component and all of its children. The label and unselected icon keep the parent's text color.
